component.name: Tailgate
component.summary: Manage Tailscale and its Mullvad exit nodes

description.p: Tailgate is a desktop app for Tailscale. Pick an exit node by city or country, turn Mullvad on and off, allow LAN access, see your devices and what this machine serves, and check what sites see, without the command line.

Tailgate needs Tailscale installed and signed in. If it isn't, Tailgate's first page installs it with one click and one password on Ubuntu, Zorin OS, Linux Mint and Pop!_OS, then opens the sign-in page. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Tailscale Inc. or Mullvad VPN AB.
Notarized, stapled macOS build and the fawn icon. Same app as 0.2.1 otherwise.
A .deb package for Ubuntu, Zorin OS, Linux Mint and Pop!_OS, and a setup guide inside the app when Tailscale isn't installed or signed in yet, and a new icon.
